flashcard_questions.q: Which image does Macbeth use for himself once he is trapped in his castle?
flashcard_questions.a: A bear tied to a stake: ‘I cannot fly, / But, bear-like, I must fight the course.’

flashcard_questions.q: Which Jacobean blood sport lies behind Macbeth's ‘tied me to a stake’ image?
Which order from Malcolm brings Birnam Wood to Dunsinane?
flashcard_questions.a: ‘Let every soldier hew him down a bough / And bear't before him.’

flashcard_questions.q: Which term means an outcome that is the opposite of what was expected?
Which insult does Macduff hurl at Macbeth as he confronts him?
What does the compound noun ‘hell-hound’ suggest about Macbeth?
flashcard_questions.a: He has become a demonic, predatory creature hunting Scotland relentlessly.

flashcard_questions.q: Which reply does Macduff give when Macbeth refuses to fight him?
How was Macduff born, so defeating the witches' prophecy?
flashcard_questions.a: He was ‘from his mother's womb / Untimely ripp'd’ — a Caesarean delivery.

flashcard_questions.q: Which term means the tragic hero's moment of recognising the truth?
What does Macbeth call the witches once he understands their deception?
flashcard_questions.a: ‘juggling fiends’ that ‘palter with us in a double sense’.

flashcard_questions.q: Which warning from Banquo in Act One is proved right at the end?
flashcard_questions.a: ‘The instruments of darkness tell us truths, / Win us with honest trifles, to betray's / In deepest consequence.’

flashcard_questions.q: Which line shows Macbeth choosing to fight on after his doom is certain?
How does Malcolm describe Macbeth and his wife in the closing speech?
flashcard_questions.a: ‘this dead butcher and his fiend-like queen’

flashcard_questions.q: Which traditional site hosts Malcolm's coronation?
Which term means the fatal flaw that causes a tragic hero's downfall?

notes: 15 cards: 7 character or theme to quotation, 4 definition-front term cards phrased 'Which term means…' with one-word answers (bear-baiting, situational irony, anagnorisis, hamartia), 2 quotation-to-effect, 1 plot fact (Caesarean birth), 1 context card (Scone). Dropped peripeteia — the lesson itself says its placement is disputed, so no single answer is self-gradable. Dropped the thematic overview section: it is essay material, not flashcardable.
